card.name: Four-letter endings on biologic drug names
card.fires_on: The letters of the four-letter suffix added after a hyphen in biologic drug names, such as trastuzumab-qyyp. It fires on the first piece of that suffix.

modes.label: Suffix after hyphen
modes.description: The first letters of the random four-letter suffix right after the hyphen in an antibody name.

modes.label: Hyphen starting the suffix
modes.description: The hyphen-plus-letter piece that opens the suffix when the name is written without a space.
modes.example: intravenous administration of margetuximab<<-c>>mkb to pregnant cynomolgus

card.writes: It pushes the model toward odd letter fragments completing the suffix, and away from common letters like Y and Z.
card.plain: It marks the spot inside an antibody drug name where the made-up four-letter ending begins.
